goal: 経理チームが、開発者の手を借りずに、明細から請求書を自分たちで印刷できる。経理チームのメンバーは、ガイドだけを頼りに、明細のファイルからコマンド一つで請求書を印刷する。

deliverable.name: 経理チームのメンバーが、明細のファイルを渡すだけで、印刷できる請求書を得る

judges_by.what: Maintainers, people or AI agents, change what the code does and know that every behavior its specification asks for still holds, as the code holds only those behaviors, and whoever runs the code can fix a wrong input from outside.

critical_success_factors.what: The maintainer finds the one place where a change belongs.

necessary_conditions.what: Does each module say, where the maintainer first meets it, the one thing it alone decides?
Does each name that a module offers state everything a caller needs to call it without reading its body?
Does each behavior of the code trace to a case of its specification, which is what the architecture asks of its part?

critical_success_factors.what: The tests show whether every behavior still holds.

necessary_conditions.what: Do the tests pass in any order and on every run, on a fresh machine set up from the code's setup alone?
Does each case of the specification, its edges and refusals included, have one test whose name says the case?
Do the tests call the code only as its callers do, through its interfaces?
Does each test assert the whole result of its case, with coverage leaving no line that no case calls for?

critical_success_factors.what: Whoever runs the code can fix a wrong input from outside.

necessary_conditions.what: Does the code refuse a wrong input from outside before it acts, with a message from which whoever ran it can fix the input?
